name: Code Generator
description: Generate code for any REST request in a .void file, in JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, PHP, Ruby, C#, Swift, Kotlin, Rust, Dart and more.
author: Phurpa Tsering
readme: Open a .void file, then choose Actions (☰) → Generate code. Pick a language in the modal (JavaScript fetch by default), switch between requests in the file, choose whether to resolve {{variables}} from the active environment, and copy the result.

ui.description: Adds a Generate code entry to the .void Actions menu

features: 21 languages and 38 clients, covering every language Postman's code generator offers
JavaScript (fetch) by default; the last language you picked is remembered
Works on the request under the cursor, with a picker for multi-request files
Keeps {{variables}} as placeholders, or resolves them from the active environment
Same request as Copy as cURL: headers, query and path params, cookies, auth, and JSON/XML/YAML/form/multipart bodies
